subject: The Autumn Edit
previewText: Satin, velvet and the colours of the season.
heading: The Autumn Edit
body:
Liquid satin for long evenings, velvet for the first cold nights. Our autumn pieces arrive in limited numbers, and Letter readers see them first.

Each is cut in Lisbon and finished by hand. When a colour is gone, it is gone for the season.

subject: Private sale: Letter readers first
heading: A private sale, for Letter readers
body:
For two days, selected evening pieces are offered to Letter readers before they reach the shop.

The selection is small and will not be restocked.

heading: Gifts, chosen slowly
